subject: Request: PLG trial top-up for HexaHealth – approval needed
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PLG trial top-up for HexaHealth – approval needed

Team,

Quick ask — HexaHealth is a high-priority pilot prospect (see deal RW-2026-HEXA-039). They hit our standard PLG trial credit cap last week and have requested an additional 300k token top-up to complete a 6-week technical evaluation tied to a live customer dataset.

Why this matters:
- HexaHealth is a clinical SaaS vendor with strong distribution into regional hospital systems (probable expansion in Q4).
- Their usage profile indicates high per-token revenue potential if the pilot converts (estimated $120k ARR if successful).
- The team needs the extra tokens to finish their integration tests and run a single end-to-end inference workload that validates latency and cost at scale.

Ask:
- Approval for a one-time trial top-up of 300,000 tokens (non-billable) beyond standard PLG credit limits.
- Approval window: 6 weeks, after which usage data will be reviewed.

Attachments: hexah-health-poc-plan.pdf, hexah-usage-forecast.xlsx, deal-desk-topup-request.csv

I've summarized the conversion assumptions in the attached forecast and included a proposed success criteria checklist in the POC plan. If we approve, I recommend we condition approval on a short MOU (1 paragraph) confirming data handling and that we can instrument usage telemetry.

Thanks — I can jump on a quick call if useful.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PLG trial top-up for HexaHealth – approval needed

Karthik,

Thanks for the concise ask — appreciate the attachments. A couple quick clarifying questions before I can sign off or elevate to Vivek for exception: 

1) Conversion signal: what metric will we use to mark pilot success (e.g., number of hospital integrations, API calls/day, or committed spend)?
2) Risk/backstop: what happens to tokens not consumed after 6 weeks? Can we cap token use by route/model to limit exposure?
3) Contractual: do we need any temporary TDAs or an MOU to capture controls?

From the forecast it looks reasonable but I'd like explicit success criteria and a plan for curtailed usage. If you can update the CSV with a per-week usage ramp and the success criteria, I'll route for approval.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

On Fri, May 15, 2026 at 09:15 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PLG trial top-up for HexaHealth – approval needed

Marissa —

Answers inline and updated attachments attached. Key points: 
- Success criteria: At least 3 hospital integrations demonstrating <200ms 95th percentile latency and an initial commit to a paid pilot showing intent to deploy (letter of intent / procurement note).
- Risk control: We've scoped the top-up to specific routes and the SNI for their tenant; the usage is limited to the inference route used in the POC (model: rdx-small).
- Unused tokens: any remaining tokens will expire at the end of the 6-week window and will not roll forward.

I've updated deal-desk-topup-request.csv with per-week caps and included a 2-week check-in milestone (week 2) so we can abort early if usage diverges. HexaHealth has agreed to sign a 1-paragraph MOU for data handling and telemetry.

I'm tagging Stephanie for product validation on the model route and runtime constraints.

Thanks,
— Karthik

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: PLG trial top-up for HexaHealth – approval needed

Team —

I reviewed the plan and attachments. I approve a one-time, non-billable top-up of 300,000 tokens to HexaHealth under the following conditions: 

1) Top-up is bound to the tenant SNI and the specific inference route (rdx-small) as described. No cross-tenant usage allowed.
2) Tokens expire automatically after the 6-week evaluation window.
3) Product (Stephanie) to confirm the per-route throttles are in place before tokens are provisioned.
4) Commercial Ops (Marissa) to log the exception in the deal desk tracker and confirm the MOU has been executed with HexaHealth procurement.

Karthik — please coordinate with procurement and Ops to get the MOU signed and confirm telemetry hooks. Once Marissa confirms the tracker entry and Stephanie confirms throttles, Legal/Finance can be looped in for a final note but no further exec sign-off is required.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
